messages:
Nina_Sales: Sparrow follow-up: they want a short POC to prove sustained 600 qps + tail latency targets (p95 < 120ms, p99 < 320ms) for chat seq len ~256. Can we run this Fri 09:00 PST and give a quick cost ballpark?

Omar_SE: I can lead. Proposed test: hosted sandbox for smoke, reserve Dedicated pool for the 1-hr hot window to avoid noisy neighbors. Ramp 0->600 qps in 7min, hold 45min, 3 spikes to 900 qps for 30s. Mix: 55% 128t, 45% 256t.

Lina_Eng: Perf notes: redwood-medium-16k-quant expected on 4x A100 or 3x H100 depending on latency tolerance. Quantization adds ~5-9% p99 overhead. Enable prefix KV caching to reduce repeated-token costs.

Ravi_Infra: Infra items: sandbox quota bump done. Dedicated reservation needs confirmation by EOD to meet 24h provisioning. VPC peering asked for in security QA; that adds ~2 business days.

Nina_Sales: Sparrow also asked about KMS/HSM and SOC2 blurb for the questionnaire. Ravi, can you post the short answers we can share?

Ravi_Infra: Short answers: we support AWS/GCP KMS customer-managed keys today (docs link). HSM-backed key wrap is available as an enterprise add-on (approx 5 business days to enable). SOC2: we can share our Type II report after NDA. I'll attach the snippets.

Omar_SE: Cost ballpark: Dedicated nodes (4x A100) for 2 hours = ~$X,XXX; token cost for run ~ $150. I'll provide tidy $/hour after Lina confirms exact model variant.

Lina_Eng: Confirming numbers tonight. Also suggest a micro-smoke (50 qps) immediately to validate telemetry. I can run in 15m.

security-bot: New ticket SEC-2026-399 Sparrow POC created and assigned to security-team. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/SEC-2026-399

Nina_Sales: Action list: Omar runbook + bench command by tomorrow EOD; Ravi post KMS/SOC2 snippets; Lina confirm node count and $/hr delta. I'll tentatively tell Sparrow Fri 09:00 PST pending Dedicated confirm. Thanks!
